_comment: Fills the {{DO_NOT_TRANSLATE_LIST}}, {{GLOSSARY}} and {{TONE}} slots in prompts/translate-ui.txt and prompts/translate-audio.txt. Edit freely: the file is re-read on change, and a change refreshes cached translations (it is part of the prompt version). do_not_translate: words kept as written. glossary: {"English term": "translation for every language"} or {"English term": {"de": "...", "fr": "..."}}. tone: e.g. "friendly and professional".
